english: While we call upon the help of the Holy Trinity, Father, Son and Holy Spirit, the one true God,
we begin to write out the book of the Chronography of the sons of men,
composed by Mar Gregory the Maphrian,
the light of the East and of the West,
who is Abu'l-Faraj son of Aaron the physician, of the city {OCR?} of Melitene,
and who is called Bar Hebraeus (son of the Hebrew).
First, a supplication.
O God, help my weakness.
Blessed are You, Lord and Master of every beginning and starting point,
You are the First and You are the Last.
And to You every ascent is directed,
and to You all thanksgiving is due.
And to the Son, the Word, the power of Your wisdom,
and to the Holy Spirit, the life of Your being,
from eternity, and now, and forever.
And since this rational living being was created to know the righteousness that it should praise and the good that it should find,
and that first knowledge comes in abundance from theoretical reasonings,
and this second abundantly from practical hearings,
the remembrance of events, then, which in every generation good and evil men have performed,
provides no small benefit to all those who are concerned to acquire goodness
and are anxious to hate evil.
While for the excellences of the former, one who reads is urged to examine diligently,
and from the disgraces of the latter, one who repeats them is driven to flee with haste.
